verdict.rationale: Lium is a GPU rental marketplace, so reserved or committed-use discounts are a fair question to ask of it. Its own pricing page states it bills per second 'with no minimum and no reservation', and nothing in the evidence describes commitment-based discounts. Spend caps, budgets and price ceilings are cost controls, not discounted capacity commitments.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can lock in reserved or committed-use discounts for sustained GPU capacity
